text:
Ivy: Cheddar discovered the parking-lot puddle and decided it was a personal spa. Photo drop: https://i.imgur.com/7kQpLzH.jpg :joy:
Marcus: Full belly-flop. He is committed. :rofl: :paw_prints:
Talia: That leaf stuck to his ear is peak drama. :leafy_green: :crown:
Sam: Is he ok? Any towel needs? :sweat_smile:
Zoe: I have a towel in my bag and some training treats. On my way. :running_woman: :towel:
Ivy: Bringing him inside now — he tried to sneak a second puddle on the walk back. Cheddar: "meetings are optional". :eyes:
Marcus: Can we petition for an official Cheddar break at the 3pm standup? Morale will spike. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Talia: Vote: Cheddar = Office Morale Officer. React with 👍 or 👎.
Sam: +1 (and a treat budget).
lunchbot: Lunch poll — "Pup-themed cookies?" yes: 9 no: 2
Zoe: Quick pet photoshoot in the kitchen in ~10? Bring treats and non-squeaky toys. 📸
Ivy: Cheddar is now in a tiny towel burrito and judging my outfit choices. Thanks Zoe! :heart:
Marcus: Also routing this to "cute photos" folder in my brain. Will subpoena more pics later. :camera_with_flash:
Talia: Next time bring a leaf crown, he nails medieval vibes. :crown: :fallen_leaf:
Sam: Note to self: always carry an extra towel. Cheddar is a chaos agent but a good one. :sparkles:
